title: Polynomial sample-count bound
statement: Let $n,C,Q$ be natural numbers, let $t$ be a positive rational, and let $\varepsilon$ be rational with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. Suppose $1\le n$, $1/(Q+1)\le\varepsilon$, and $t\le(C+1)(\sqrt{\operatorname{clog}_2(n+1)}+1)$. Set $E=(8(C+1)(Q+1))^4+8(8(C+1)(Q+1)+1)+4$. Then the sample count is at most $2560\cdot 2^{2E}(n+1)^{E+1}$.
